# Event: Well Equipped (All Rewards)

![Event: Well Equipped (All Rewards)](/uploads/590_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

The Burning Springs update expands the map from Appalachia west into the Ohio desert. There are numerous changes, new quests, new enemies, new weapons and new events. One of the **new public events is "Well Equipped".** This event will probably run again on the hour in the honeymoon phase for 14 days after the release of Burning Springs on **December 2nd, 2025** together with the "Event: Valley Battle". The events will then be included in the normal public event rotation and will start randomly every 20 minutes alongside all other public events.

![Location: Jackson's Junkyard (Event: Gearin`Up)](/uploads/nukaknights-post-event-gearin-up-location.jpg) 

The Gearin` Up event takes place at **Jackson's Junkyard** in the Ohio desert. Here you meet the Beastmasters. This explains to you that the death claws for the Rust King come from this place. There they are raised and trained for battle in the wasteland or in the arena. Your job is to equip a **Deathclaw** with **armor** and prepare it for a fight while you are attacked by raiders. To do this, collect material for the armor. Once enough scrap metal has been collected, the Deathclaw receives its armor and can compete against a larger Deathclaw. The goal is to **protect** them.

Legendary enemies spawn during the event and the Deathclaw in the finale is also legendary. From these enemies you will receive legendary items such as weapons and armor.

### Well Equipped: Event Rewards

- 1000 XP
- 1000 bottle caps
- 1-3 Legendary Modules
- 3 government bonds
- 1-2 Rad-X / Rad-X diluted
- Random ammo
- 1 Stimpak / Super Stimpak
